summary: Short kerb at a junction mouth, steep and wooded, with no room to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the east side, but house 23 m and garage 18 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 14 m, at a junction with a median island; wooded bank leaves no pull-off.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a car moving nearby; junction turning traffic.
drivers.convention: No cars seen parked along this stretch.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the east side; shaded much of the day.
